messages.content: Find me a documentary about global warming.

function.name: retrieve_scientific_paper
function.description: Fetches the details of scientific research paper based on its topic. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

year.description: Year of publishing of the research paper. If not specified, fetches the most recent paper

author.description: Author of the research paper. If not specified, fetches the paper with most citations

message.content:
Here’s a quick list of well‑known documentaries you might enjoy:

| Title | Release year | Synopsis |
|-------|--------------|----------|
| **“An Inconvenient Truth”** | 2006 | Former Vice President Al Gore presents climate science data and urges action against global warming. |
| **“An Inconvenient Sequel: Truth to Power”** | 2017 | A continuation featuring new evidence and policy discussions since the first film. |
| **“Before the Flood”** | 2019 | Leonardo DiCaprio travels worldwide to explore human impact on Earth and potential solutions. |
| **“Climate Change – The Facts”** | 2018 | BBC series explaining causes, impacts, and mitigation strategies. |
| **“Our Planet” (Season 1)** | 2019 | Narrated by David Attenborough, it shows how climate change threatens wildlife habitats globally. |

If you’re looking for something more niche—such as short films, regional focus, or interactive experiences—or have preferences regarding runtime, format (TV vs streaming), or availability platform, let me know! I’ll tailor recommendations accordingly.
